title: Conventional Keyboards Are STAGGERINGLY STUPID!
summary: Ben Vallack compares finger movement on a staggered keyboard with an ortholinear grid keyboard, using an Anne Pro 2 and a ZSA Planck EZ. He argues the stagger forces awkward finger motion.
why: HN links it in keyboard threads as a short visual demonstration of why staggered layouts force unnatural finger movement.

quote.text: These videos [2][3] from Ben Vallack demonstrate this nicely.
